newsitem.title: USA: Fed does not intervene in open market Friday.
newsitem.headline: Fed does not intervene in open market Friday.

text.p: The Federal Reserve stayed out of the open market during its mid-morning open market intervention period on Friday.
The non-action was expected, given that the Fed executed both overnight and 6-day fixed system repurchase agreements on Thursday, and Fed funds were trading below target.
Funds were at 5-3/16 percent and traded as low as 5-1/8 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target rate.
U.S. bond markets close at 1400 EST/1900 GMT on Friday and will be closed on Monday in observance of Martin Luther King Jr Day.
